# jumpcloud_default_access_policy (Resource)

Manages one of JumpCloud's four fallback access policies ("Default Access Policy Settings" on the MFA Configurations admin page): application, userportal, adminportal, or ldap. Built from a captured browser request -- not documented anywhere else.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `resource_type` (String) Which fallback policy to manage: "application", "userportal", "adminportal", or "ldap" (all four confirmed live).

### Optional

- `effect_action` (String) The fallback policy's base access decision. Confirmed live value: "allow".
- `mfa_required` (Boolean) Require MFA under this fallback policy.
- `user_verification` (String) WebAuthn-style user verification requirement: "discouraged", "preferred", or "required" (values confirmed on jumpcloud_authentication_policy and jumpcloud_push_settings; not independently varied for this resource during capture -- only "none" was observed).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
